title: List installed fonts for a specific language
summary: Find which installed fonts support a particular language or script.

steps.explain: Use fc-list with the lang filter to show fonts supporting a specific language code.

placeholders.name: LANG_CODE
placeholders.description: Two-letter language code (e.g., ar for Arabic, ru for Russian)

verify.expect: A list of font files that support Arabic glyphs is displayed.
